sections.text: We don't guess. We apply our *signature landing page engineering* within your digital ecosystem to replicate that success.
prose: A landing page has a single mission: to lead one specific visitor to take one specific action. Every element that doesn't serve that action is friction.
A sales funnel goes further: it chains several pages and steps (landing page, form, confirmation, follow-up) to guide a person from interest to decision.

sections.p: Tell us which action you want. We'll design the page that leads to it.

a: A landing page is a single web page created for one specific action: request a quote, book a call, sign up. Unlike a full site, it removes navigation and distractions to focus the visitor on that goal.

faq.q: What's the difference between a landing page and a sales funnel?
a: A landing page is a single page. A sales funnel is a sequence of steps (for example: landing page, form, confirmation page, follow-up emails) that guides a person to a purchase or contact decision.

faq.q: What makes a landing page convert?
a: The elements that matter most: a clear offer on the first screen, a single call to action, credible social proof, answers to objections, fast loading on mobile and a form without needless friction.

faq.q: Do I need to run ads for it to work?
a: No, but ads speed up results: a good page turns every click into more inquiries. We've achieved up to a 3,500% increase in inquiries with minimal ad budgets. See also our [digital advertising](@publicite) service.

faq.q: How soon will I see results?
a: The first data arrives as soon as the page receives traffic. The pace depends on your visitor volume; we track conversions from launch and adjust based on what the data shows.
